description_en: Queries all data forwarding actions under a specified rule
description_zh: 调用该接口查询指定规则下的所有转发数据动作列表
name: ListRuleActions

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If an ID value is displayed, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.
If no Overview page or ID value is displayed, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无实例概览页面或ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the rule to query.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69486.html operation and view the Id in the response
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的规则ID。

您可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69486.html接口从返回结果中查看**Id**
parameters.name: rule_id

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

RuleActionInfo.description_en: The list of all data destinations under the rule returned if the call is successful. For more information, see the parameters included in RuleActionInfo
RuleActionInfo.description_zh: 调用成功后，返回规则下所有数据目的列表。详细信息，请参见以下RuleActionInfo所包含的参数

Configuration.description_en: The configuration information corresponding to the data destination
Configuration.description_zh: 数据目的对应的配置信息

ErrorActionFlag.description_en:
Indicates whether this data destination configuration is for forwarding error operation data, which is data that failed to be forwarded to other cloud services and also failed after retries.

true: The configuration is for forwarding error operation data.
false: The configuration is not for forwarding error operation data, but for normal forwarding operations
ErrorActionFlag.description_zh:
该数据目的配置是否为转发错误操作数据，即转发流转到其他云产品失败且重试失败的数据。

true：是转发错误操作数据。
false：不是转发错误操作数据，而是正常转发操作

Id.description_en: The operation ID corresponding to the data destination

RuleId.description_en: The rule ID corresponding to the data destination

Status.description_en:
The status corresponding to the data destination. Valid values:
INIT: being initialized.
NORMAL: configuration completed and available.
INVALID: configuration is abnormal and unavailable.
SHORTCUT: the data forwarding service encountered an exception, causing circuit breaking
Status.description_zh:
数据目的对应的状态。返回值：
INIT：初始配置中。
NORMAL：配置完成，正常可用。
INVALID：配置存在异常，不可用。
SHORTCUT：云产品流转服务发生异常，导致流转熔断

Type.description_en:
The operation type corresponding to the data destination. Valid values:

REPUBLISH: forwards data to another topic.
OTS: stores data to Tablestore.
MNS: sends messages to Message Service.
ONS: sends data to ApsaraMQ for RocketMQ.
TSDB: stores data to Time Series Database.
FC: sends data to Function Compute.
<props="china">- DATAHUB: sends data to DataHub.</props>
RDS: stores data to ApsaraDB.
AMQP: forwards data stream to an AMQP consumer group
Type.description_zh:
数据目的对应的操作类型。返回值：

REPUBLISH：转发到另一个topic。
OTS：存储到表格存储。
MNS：发送消息到消息服务。
ONS：发送数据到消息队列RocketMQ。
TSDB：存储到时序数据库。
FC：发送数据到函数计算。
<props="china">- DATAHUB：发送数据到DataHub中。</props>
RDS：存储数据到云数据库中。
AMQP：数据流转到AMQP消费组

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。
true：表示调用成功。
false：表示调用失败
